newsitem.title: UK: Q Group shares set premium on AIM debut.
newsitem.headline: Q Group shares set premium on AIM debut.

text.p: Shares in Israel's Q Group Plc, an interactive educational publisher, set a premium on their first day of trade on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) on Friday.
By 1540 GMT the shares were quoted at 119-1/2p, ahead of their 114p issue price, although no trade was registered in the stock.

Q Group said it raised a net 3.5 million stg with a placing by broker Burrough Johnstone. The proceeds will be used to expand the company's international sales and marketing and to fund new product development.
The company said it was valued at 19.0 million stg at the issue price. Dr Roberta Stock, chief executive, said Q Group had already begun to reap the rewards of being a listed company.
"The flotation process has been very beneficial to our corporate thinking," Stock said.
"We are already benefiting from being seen as a public company and we look forward to taking advantage of all the many opportunities for us out there," she said.
